dataList.content:
So, I hear you've defeated Shi Huazhen.
我听说您打败了史华贞。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Sparring Grounds
大观园 公认武斗对练场

dataList.content:
You would do best not to let that get to your head. He's always been our family's greatest shame.
您最好可不要因此就自以为是。那家伙从前就是我们家族的耻辱。

Hey, watch yourself. Haven't you learned not to underestimate the family underdogs?
当心点，你难道不明白越是被小看的家伙就越不能掉以轻心吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
What...?
什么……？

Oh, you don't know? You see, I managed to talk Shi Huazhen into... you know?
原来你还不知道吗……？我设法说服了史华贞去……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
W-what? No, it can't be. He cannot have spilled the beans on my parents'—
您、您都做了什么？难道说，您居然对我们父母所在的……

Haah... My men are already on their way.
呼……我的手下已经去到那边了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Ngh...! But how did you know it was Block 32?! I barely managed to get them a hiding spot there...
可恶……！我费了多少力气才把他们藏到三十二号街区……

Oh, so it's Block 32.
啊，原来就在那儿啊。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... Did you just—?
……您诈我？

I did. Huh, that was way easier than it was during class.
对啊。我照着学到的试了一下，居然比上课的时候还简单呢？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I've heard stories about how you've changed... I didn't know you had changed into such a heartless woman!
我早听说您变了，变了……但没想到您居然变成了如此厚颜无耻之徒！

Hm.
嗯哼。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Say something, dammit! Don't just stand there completely expressionless and—
该死的，您倒是说话啊！竟然还一副吊儿郎当的样子——

Mm.
嗯。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Oh, I see. You won't be shaken by silly little things like this, is that it?
您的意思是，这种鸡毛蒜皮的小事对您而言根本不值一提，是吗？

Mmm.
嗯哼。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... That may befit the seat of the Hierarch. However...
……您这个样子，倒也许配得上家主之位。不过……

... a leader who responds with silence to their inferiors, a leader who considers them only disposable tools is bound to rot!
把下属当做只用沉默听命、用完就丢的工具的领导者，终将腐败不堪！

I, Shi Sijing, refuse to let someone so unqualified such as yourself retain power!
我史思静，绝不会放任如此无能之辈掌权而坐视不理！
